title: 5999--New Building Automation System (BAS) Sustainment, Maintenance, Repair, and Lifecycle | PO: VA American Lakes Campus, Tacoma, Washington
scope_summary: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) is seeking a contractor to provide sustainment services for its mission-critical Building Automation System (BAS) at the American Lake VA Medical Center. The services include 24/7 technical support, preventive and corrective maintenance, replacement of end-of-life hardware, and optimization services. The BAS ecosystem includes proprietary controllers, supervisory controllers, operator workstations, networked building controls, and integrated analytics, digital twin, and performance optimization platforms.

title: indefinite delivery architect-engineer services multiple award task order contract (matoc) for mechinical-electrical design and related projects, primarily various locations, alaska - w911kb27ra006
scope_summary: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) is seeking architect-engineer firms for an Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) Multiple Award Task Order Contract (MATOC) for mechanical-electrical design and related projects, primarily in various locations in Alaska. The contract requires capabilities in BIM modeling and LEED energy consumption modeling, and the ability to provide designs using BIM software.

title: Lethal Innovation Foundry Technologies (LIFT) Program
tendering_authority: U.S. Army Contracting Command – New Jersey (ACC-NJ)
scope_summary: The U.S. Army Contracting Command – New Jersey (ACC-NJ) is conducting market research for the Lethal Innovation Foundry Technologies (LIFT) Program. They are seeking responses from US and Canadian companies with capabilities in advanced/additive manufacturing techniques, digital twin modeling, and simulation software for ballistics or durability testing. This is a Sources Sought notice, not a request for proposal.
